:::{#def-piecewise-constant-schedule}
#### Piecewise constant schedule

Let $\iterpoint{\steplen}{0} > 0$ be the [step length](#def-gradient-descent) before update $1$,
let $\decay \in (0, 1)$ be a drop factor,
and let $t_1 < t_2 < \cdots$ be update counts.
The **piecewise constant schedule** is

$$
\iterpoint{\steplen}{t} \eqdef \iterpoint{\steplen}{0}\,\decay^{k(t)},
\qquad
k(t) \eqdef \card{\set{j : t_j \le t}}.
$$

:::
